briefdescription.para: Backend domain modules that hold the project's business logic, isolated from the HTTP transport layer.

detaileddescription.para: The lib/ directory is the backend's domain layer: filesystem access, environment loading, error taxonomy. Everything here is pure Node.js with zero third-party runtime dependencies, consumed exclusively by server.js (the transport layer) and mirrored conceptually by the frontend's assets/js/services/resource-service.js data layer.

Members:
lib/files-service.js — filesystem domain layer (see its file page, linked from this group's member list)
lib/load-env.js — .env bootstrap (planned page)
